summary: Off-highway vehicle (Jeep Cherokee XJ) rolled several times at the Jaws 2 obstacle on Lake Como Road on Blanca Peak, ejecting both occupants; the driver suffered fatal injuries and the passenger received non-life-threatening injuries. Alamosa Volunteer SAR responded with two rock crawlers, getting the injured party out and bringing the deceased driver off the mountain; the Alamosa County Sheriff's Office and Colorado State Patrol documented the scene. Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery recovered the wrecked vehicle on September 18 and released it to a friend of the deceased.
location: Lake Como Road (Jaws 2 obstacle), Blanca Peak
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR; Alamosa County Sheriff's Office; Colorado State Patrol
notes: Date pinned to 2022-09-09 via the AVSAR mission page (State Patrol dispatch contact date = accident date; AVSAR page title). The 4x4 report covers the Sept 18 vehicle recovery and names the obstacle as Jaws 1 vs AVSAR's Jaws 2 — recorded as same incident (dates + XJ + fatal driver + friend-of-deceased coordination match). Victim identities not published in sources found.
